input.content:
Biogas plant BGA10 consists of two parallel digestion lines that are merged only in the digestate store. Two solid feeders (Dos 1 and Dos 2, 50 cubic metres each, hydraulic push-floor) charge digesters F1 and F2 respectively; two pre-pits (6×8 m each, approx. 25 cubic metres) pump cattle slurry into F1 and F2 respectively.

Digesters F1 and F2 each have a diameter of 27 m and a wall height of 6 m, are equipped with three paddle agitators each and carry dome roofs; they are operated mesophilically. The digestate continues line by line: from F1 into post-digester N1 and from F2 into post-digester N2. Both post-digesters are structurally identical to the digesters (27 m diameter, 6 m wall height, dome roof, heated) and fitted with one paddle and one long-axis agitator each. From N1 and N2 the digestate passes into the shared digestate store G1 with 32 m diameter, 8 m wall height and three submersible agitators; the store is unheated.

The biogas of all tanks runs through a gas collecting pipe to a CHP unit with a rated electrical output of 750 kW; besides the digester heating the heat supplies a small district heating network. Air is blown into the gas spaces of N1 and N2 for desulphurisation. An emergency flare rated 900 cubic metres per hour and a condensate shaft are present.

oracle.substrate_feed: je 20 t/d Maissilage über die Dosierer (Dos 1 in F1, Dos 2 in F2) und je 15 m³/d Rindergülle aus den Vorgruben (in F1 und F2); die Nachgärer und das Gärrestlager erhalten keinen Frischfeed
oracle.digestate_cascade: zwei getrennte Linien: F1->N1 und F2->N2; beide Nachgärer geben in dasselbe Gärrestlager ab (N1->G1, N2->G1). F1 und F2 speisen NICHT denselben Nachgärer
oracle.gas_routing: Alle fünf Behälter (F1, F2, N1, N2, G1) speisen das BHKW
